products.text:
Type: industrial rectangular coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, rustic, modern
Materials: slatted solid wood top, black metal frame
Colors: warm medium brown wood, black
Shape: long low rectangle, plank top set into a metal rim, closed square-tube sled legs at each end, open underneath, wide and grounded
Feel: sturdy, warm, loft-like
Goes with: leather sofas, black accents, exposed brick, grey or white walls; industrial or rustic living rooms

Type: round carved drum coffee table
Use: holding drinks and decor beside or in front of seating; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, rustic, coastal
Materials: carved mango wood, whitewashed finish
Colors: light warm greige wood, white wash
Shape: cylindrical drum, pierced lattice pattern all around, round top with molded rim, plinth base, compact but solid
Feel: textured, relaxed, earthy, crafted
Goes with: rattan, linen, plants, white walls, natural tones; bohemian or coastal living rooms

Type: tray-top coffee table
Use: serving and storing items in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, mid-century modern, modern
Materials: wood trays in walnut finish, dark metal frame
Colors: warm walnut brown, dark gunmetal grey
Shape: rectangular, two removable rimmed trays of unequal size, thin square-tube open frame with center supports and low stretchers, light and open
Feel: warm, practical, refined
Goes with: leather, brass or black accents, warm neutral walls; industrial or mid-century living rooms

Type: square X-frame coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: pine plank top, bronze-toned metal frame
Colors: light greyish natural wood, dark bronze
Shape: low square, thin metal frame with X-braces on each side, plank top inset in a metal edge, open and airy, medium size
Feel: casual, airy, rugged
Goes with: linen sofas, weathered wood, neutral walls, black or bronze accents; farmhouse or industrial living rooms

Type: coffee table with drawers
Use: storage and serving in front of a sofa; living room
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: painted wood, satin nickel knobs
Colors: deep raspberry red, silver
Shape: rectangular, two front drawers with round knobs, geometric square fretwork cutouts on the sides, lower shelf, straight square legs, medium visual weight
Feel: cheerful, bold, homey
Goes with: cream, white or navy, patterned textiles, light wood; eclectic or traditional living rooms

Type: minimalist open coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: engineered wood, wenge laminate finish
Colors: dark chocolate brown
Shape: low rectangle, flat top over a lower shelf, slab panel supports at ends and center, no legs, compact and boxy
Feel: clean, simple, grounded
Goes with: white or light grey sofas, light rugs, white walls; minimalist or modern living rooms

Type: wood coffee table with drawer
Use: storage and serving in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, mid-century modern, rustic
Materials: reclaimed-look solid wood, dark metal trim, legs and handles
Colors: warm mixed brown wood, gunmetal grey
Shape: long low rectangular box, wide front drawer with two bar pulls, metal-banded edges, splayed tapered metal legs, solid and substantial
Feel: warm, rugged, retro
Goes with: leather, cognac and black accents, neutral walls; industrial or mid-century living rooms

Type: wood end table with drawer
Use: lamp or drink beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, rustic, classic
Materials: solid oak, medium oak finish, dark metal pull
Colors: warm honey oak, black
Shape: half-round top, single front drawer, slightly splayed square legs, lower shelf, compact and upright
Feel: warm, homey, crafted
Goes with: earthy tones, leather, cream walls; Craftsman, traditional or cottage rooms

Type: round marble side table
Use: drink or lamp beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: modern, glam, contemporary
Materials: white marble top and lower shelf, brushed stainless steel frame
Colors: white with grey veining, cool silver grey
Shape: round two-tier, thin metal rims, slim flat vertical supports on one side, open and light, compact
Feel: elegant, cool, airy
Goes with: grey, white, velvet, chrome or glass accents; modern or glam rooms

Type: X-base square side table
Use: drink or lamp beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: industrial, rustic, modern
Materials: mango wood top with patchwork grain, black metal base
Colors: light warm natural wood, black
Shape: square top, crossed X-shaped legs on two sides joined by floor runners, open and compact
Feel: casual, sturdy, warm
Goes with: leather, black accents, neutral walls, natural wood; industrial or rustic rooms
